source.name: Ballpark Digest: Coors Field Naming Rights Run in Perpetuity
source.quote: Naming rights to the ballpark are to be in perpetuity, a benefit that Coors and its successors was granted as part a $30 million investment made before the facility opened

note: Stadium naming rights: Coors Field. Start date unknown: the naming benefit was granted before the ballpark opened in 1995; the article (31 Oct 2019) says the agreement runs in perpetuity.
